headline: Rain brings relief from heat, disrupts traffic in Dhaka
summary: After a period of intense heat, rainfall in the capital has lowered temperatures but caused waterlogging and traffic congestion.
details: Rainfall in Dhaka has provided much-needed relief from the oppressive heatwave that had been affecting the city.
However, the rain has also led to significant traffic disruptions across various parts of the capital.
Waterlogging on several key roads has slowed down the movement of vehicles and pedestrians alike.
Weather forecasts indicate a risk of thunderstorms and rain with wind speeds of up to 60 kmph in Dhaka and several other districts tonight.
